title: Dog Night, 2008 · before
logline: The night before nine years: the alley, and the bulb over the dumpster lit — new, white, wrong. Somebody replaced it. Wood stands under it a long time. The dog does his job at the corner regardless of the lighting.

panels.composition: The alley at night. The bulb over the dumpster LIT, white. WOOD stopped under it. BARNABY at the corner.
